scope: 31 metropolitan areas in the existing portal cohort
method: Sum of city-specific annual means, from the same cessation scenario and mean.and.interval unfaceted incidence output. City uncertainty bounds are retained as source evidence but not combined. No pooled uncertainty interval is inferred.

publicationComparison.note: Portal aggregation and original published analysis differ. No explanation of the difference is inferred; do not label portal values as the paper’s estimate.
